title: overview / Choose how you work
content:
## Choose how you work Switch between different experiences depending on your task, and [continue agent sessions across interfaces](#continue-across-interfaces-and-machines) to pick up where you left off.

Write code with assistance

Get inline suggestions as you type, including suggestions for your next edit.

Collaborate alongside your code

Work with an agent in the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %}, focused on the current workspace alongside your editor, terminal, tests, and debugger.

Delegate and coordinate work

Assign tasks and manage agent sessions across projects in the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}.
An [agent](/docs/agents/concepts/agents.md) uses a model and tools to find relevant code, make changes, and run checks. Both the {% data variables.copilot.chat_view %} and the {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} run agents. You set the goal, guide the work, and review the results. For routine work, save a prompt as an [automation](/docs/agents/run/automations.md). Run it locally on a schedule, or use cloud automations `feature(cloud-automations)` for scheduled or event-triggered repository work that continues while your computer is off. Review a manual run before enabling recurring work. For a focused edit, use [inline chat](/docs/chat/inline-chat.md) without leaving your code. To compare features for a specific task, use the [AI features cheat sheet](/docs/agents/reference/ai-features-cheat-sheet.md#choose-a-feature).
